scope: All seventeen canonical use cases and the twelve standalone public lessons under /university/learn in the current resource registry.
boundary: This register proves that each represented use case or standalone lesson has a canonical public page, substantive checked-in guidance, evidence and limitation metadata, and an honest read-only publication boundary. It does not certify implementation outcomes, professional suitability, ongoing maintenance, current vendor features, external execution, course completion, grading, credentials, or the 118 course-lesson records governed with their parent courses under R05.
